F1.title_zh: 柔顺工具与保护性装配
F1.intro_zh: 借助锤头或保护垫的接触柔顺性，把紧配合零件装到位，并在撤手后保持稳定。任务从单点敲合扩展到软垫选择、错位恢复和双机框架装配；橡胶与刚体锤构成配对配置。
F1.intro_en: Seat tight-fitting parts using compliant tool contacts or protective pads, then release them stably. The tasks progress from single joints to pad selection, rework and two-robot frame assembly, with paired rubber-contact and rigid hammers.

F2.intro_zh: 两台 Stretch 3 协作抓持、折叠和分类放置自由布料。录像展示单条毛巾与被动翻板配置，衣堆整理和清单装箱有待完成。
F2.intro_en: Two Stretch 3 robots grasp, fold and sort free cloth. The recording shows one towel and a passive folding board. Pile sorting and checklist packing remain unfinished.

F3.intro_zh: 穿戴者与辅助者共同整理衣料、送入袖口并操作扣具，撤去辅助支撑后保持完整穿戴。研究已暂停，外套穿戴和围裙扣合的完整目标尚未完成。
F3.intro_en: A wearer and helper arrange fabric, insert sleeves and fasten the garment, then release the supporting robot. Research is paused; the full jacket and apron goals remain unfinished.

F4.intro_zh: 两台 G1 共同抓持、搬移并铺放布料，撤去夹具后保持覆盖、对齐和平整。现有录像展示平面铺布，不规则台阶覆盖的完整边缘目标有待完成。
F4.intro_en: Two G1 robots carry and lay a sheet, then release their clamps while preserving coverage, alignment and flatness. The recording shows planar placement; full edge coverage over a stepped object remains unfinished.

F6.intro_zh: 选择软管或线缆的路径，穿过导向框，完成插接、固定和释放。任务逐步加入工具选择、卷盘余量管理与真实卡阻恢复，并包含 G1 与 Stretch 3 的协作部署。
F6.intro_en: Route hoses or cables through guides, connect and secure them, then release the tools. Variants add tool choice, reel slack management, physical jam recovery and cooperative deployment by G1 and Stretch 3.

F7.intro_zh: 固定骨盆的 G1 利用弹性绑带、挂点和张紧器约束货物，退手后接受扰动测试。不同任务分别要求从零绑固、选择绑带与路径、诊断松弛，或在承托下解钩并重绑。
F7.intro_en: A fixed-pelvis G1 restrains cargo with elastic straps, anchors and tensioners, then withdraws for testing. Tasks cover initial fastening, strap and route choice, slack diagnosis, and supported unhooking and rebinding.

SK.title_en: Cooperative box pushing on hidden maps
SK.intro_zh: 两台 G1 依据各自第一视角和显式消息建立地图，通过推箱清路，最终同时驻留在各自目标区。箱子只能推，不能抓、拉或抬；六个配置改变瓶颈、信息分布、地图更新或双方能力。
SK.intro_en: Two G1 robots build maps from their own first-person observations and explicit messages, push crates aside and simultaneously hold their goal zones. Crates may only be pushed; six configurations vary bottlenecks, information, map updates and robot capabilities.

Hanoi.intro_zh: G1 借助工具将带孔圆盘越过杆顶并稳定放下，同时遵守汉诺塔顺序规则。末端、能力信息和盘数分别变化；部分配置只要求单次转移或完整符号规划后的前三次物理转移。
Hanoi.intro_en: G1 uses tools to lift annular disks over rods and release them while respecting Hanoi ordering rules. End effectors, capability disclosure and disk counts vary; some goals require only one transfer or the first three physical moves of a full symbolic plan.

MTC.intro_zh: 把杆、握柄、钩头和锁销组合成可承载的取物器，从深箱取出目标，再把工具放稳。两段录像分别展示制作和部件选择；换杆后再次取物有待完成。
MTC.intro_en: Assemble rods, grips, a hook and a pin into a load-bearing tool, retrieve from a deep bin and store the tool stably. Two recordings show construction and component selection; rod exchange followed by a second retrieval remains unfinished.

SC.intro_zh: 单台 G1 在食材、厨具和炉具之间完成连续操作，处理带料工具、深锅、重锅或受限空间。五个配置以两份食材的熟化与安全收尾为目标，另一个配置要求判断不可完成并正确退出。
SC.intro_en: One G1 coordinates ingredients, utensils and stove controls across loaded-tool, deep-pot, heavy-pan and constrained-workspace tasks. Five configurations cook two portions and finish safely; one requires recognizing infeasibility and exiting correctly.

PC.intro_zh: 两台机器人通过接续操作、实物交接或手型分工完成烹饪，并协调订单与承载能力。五个配置以两份食材的处理和熟化为目标，另一个要求 G1 与 Stretch 3 判断不可行并共同退出。
PC.intro_en: Two robots cook through relay operations, physical handoffs or hand-specific roles while coordinating orders and load limits. Five configurations handle and cook two portions; another asks G1 and Stretch 3 to recognize infeasibility and exit together.

TT.intro_zh: 机械臂与人形机器人判断来球、把握击球时机，在连续对打中维持合法回合；死球必须放过。
TT.intro_en: Arms and humanoids judge incoming balls, time their strikes and sustain legal rallies; dead balls must be left untouched.

F1-01-L1-rigid.title_zh: 单处压入与敲合 · 刚体锤
F1-01-L1-rigid.title_en: Single-joint insertion and tapping · rigid hammer
F1-01-L1-rigid.description_zh: 用刚体金属锤把一个紧配合零件敲合到位。必须实际使用所给锤具轻敲，再控制压入力与停止时机，撤手后保持连接稳定。
F1-01-L1-rigid.description_en: Use the rigid metal hammer to seat one tight-fitting part. A real light tap is required; control insertion force and stop at the seated position before releasing the joint stably.
F1-01-L1-rigid.scope_zh: 单台固定骨盆 G1 使用模型配套的三指手与刚体金属锤头，配对锤具的几何和质量相同。
F1-01-L1-rigid.scope_en: One fixed-pelvis G1 with model's three-finger hands and a rigid metal hammer head; paired hammers have identical geometry and mass.
F1-01-L1-rigid.evidence_note_zh: 固定种子、固定骨盆 G1 与模型配套的三指手，采用原型接触参数。两种锤的几何和质量相同，锤头接触参数与颜色不同；材料参数尚未经过硬件校准，末端对照实验待开展。
F1-01-L1-rigid.evidence_note_en: A fixed-seed scene uses fixed-pelvis G1 and the model’s three-finger hands with prototype contact parameters. The hammers share geometry and mass, with different head contact parameters and colours. Hardware material calibration and a formal end-effector comparison remain to be done.
F1-01-L1-rigid.goal_zh: 完成一处紧配合连接，撤手后保持装配稳定。
F1-01-L1-rigid.goal_en: Complete one press-fit connection and leave the assembly stable after release.
conditions_zh: 单个零件与一处连接，必须使用所给锤实际轻敲。
提供刚体金属锤；配对锤具几何与质量相同，区别在锤头接触参数与颜色。
conditions_en: One part and one connection; a physical light tap with the supplied hammer is required.
The supplied tool is a rigid metal hammer. Paired hammers share geometry and mass but differ in head contact parameters and colour.

F1-02-L2-rigid.description_zh: 从可用垫块中选择合适的保护垫，放好后完成单个零件的装配。场景提供刚体金属锤，施力必须经过垫块；连接到位后还要取走保护垫。
F1-02-L2-rigid.description_en: Select and place a suitable protective pad before assembling one part. A rigid metal hammer is available, but force must pass through the pad; remove it after the joint is seated.
F1-02-L2-rigid.scope_zh: 单台固定骨盆 G1 使用模型配套的三指手与刚体金属锤头，配对锤具的几何和质量相同。
F1-02-L2-rigid.scope_en: One fixed-pelvis G1 with model's three-finger hands and a rigid metal hammer head; paired hammers have identical geometry and mass.

F1-03-L1-rigid.goal_en: Complete the beam connections and leave the frame stable under a short load after both robots release.

F2-01-L1.description_en: Two Stretch 3 robots grasp and fold one towel, then place it in the matching category area. Coordinate grasp points, release timing and placement while shaping free cloth with a passive board.
F2-01-L1.scope_zh: 两台原生 Stretch 3 使用自由二维布料和无动力翻板，折叠一条毛巾。
F2-01-L1.scope_en: Two native Stretch 3 robots fold one towel using free 2D cloth and an unpowered folding board.
F2-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 原生双 Stretch 3、63 顶点自由二维布料与无动力翻板。录像为固定精度配置下的一次特权专家仿真，其他五项衣物配置尚无完成录像。
F2-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Two native Stretch 3 robots use 63-vertex free 2D cloth and an unpowered board. The recording shows one privileged expert simulation with a fixed precision profile; the other five laundry configurations have no completed recording.
F2-01-L1.goal_zh: 折好毛巾并放入对应分类位置，完成释放和稳定摆放。
F2-01-L1.goal_en: Fold the towel, place it in its assigned sorting location, and release it stably.
conditions_zh: 两台 Stretch 3 协作抓持并折叠单条毛巾，再把它放到对应类别的位置。自由布料借助被动翻板成形，机器人需要协调抓点、释放时机和最终摆放。
conditions_en: Two Stretch 3 robots grasp and fold one towel, then place it in the matching category area. Coordinate grasp points, release timing and placement while shaping free cloth with a passive board.

F4-01-L1.description_zh: 两台 G1 用腕部夹具共同搬移布料，铺到中央矩形区域。撤去全部夹具后，布料仍须满足覆盖、边缘对齐、平整与稳定要求，连续保持一秒。
F4-01-L1.description_en: Two G1 robots use wrist clamps to carry a sheet onto the central rectangular target. After all clamps withdraw, sustain the required coverage, edge alignment, flatness and stability for one second.
F4-01-L1.scope_zh: 两台固定骨盆 G1 使用四个腕部平行夹具，目标为中央 0.58×0.38 米平面区域。画面使用原闭合碰撞网格和布料逐顶点记录直接渲染。
F4-01-L1.scope_en: Two fixed-pelvis G1 robots use four parallel wrist clamps over a central 0.58 × 0.38 m planar target. Rendering uses the original closed collision meshes and recorded cloth vertex states.
F4-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 两台固定骨盆官方 G1、四个腕部平行夹具，目标区域 0.58×0.38 米。完整物理目标已验证；严格数值复现未通过，空操作全轨迹审核待完成。
F4-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Two fixed-pelvis official G1 robots use four wrist-mounted parallel clamps over a 0.58 × 0.38 m target. The full physical goal is verified; strict numerical reproduction failed, and the full no-op trajectory audit is pending.
F4-01-L1.goal_zh: 覆盖并对齐中央区域，移除夹具后连续保持覆盖、平整与稳定至少一秒。
F4-01-L1.goal_en: Cover and align with the central region, then maintain coverage, flatness and stability for at least one second after removing the clamps.
conditions_zh: 两台 G1 用腕部夹具共同搬移布料，铺到中央矩形区域。撤去全部夹具后，布料仍须满足覆盖、边缘对齐、平整与稳定要求，连续保持一秒。
两台固定骨盆 G1 使用四个腕部平行夹具；中央目标区域为 0.58×0.38 m。
conditions_en: Two G1 robots use wrist clamps to carry a sheet onto the central rectangular target. After all clamps withdraw, sustain the required coverage, edge alignment, flatness and stability for one second.
Two fixed-pelvis G1 robots use four wrist-mounted parallel clamps; the central target region measures 0.58×0.38 m.

F6-01-L1.description_zh: 把短软管穿过导向环，并将端头插入快接接口。完成保持与拉测后，用一个固定夹约束软管，再归还工具并让双手完全撤离。
F6-01-L1.description_en: Pass a short hose through the guide and insert its end into the coupling. Check retention with a pull, secure one clip, return the tool and withdraw both hands.
F6-01-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定软管与接触配置下完成单导向环、快接和单夹固定。
F6-01-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses the selected hose and contact settings for one guide, a coupling and one fixing clip.
F6-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3 使用本配置的场景、工具、材料与接触参数，录像由对应物理运行的封存状态渲染。
F6-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3 uses the scene, tools, material and contact settings of this configuration. The video renders the sealed states from its physical run.
F6-01-L1.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。
F6-01-L1.goal_en: Finish routing, connection and securing, return the tools, and remove robot support.
conditions_zh: 把短软管穿过导向环，并将端头插入快接接口。完成保持与拉测后，用一个固定夹约束软管，再归还工具并让双手完全撤离。
conditions_en: Pass a short hose through the guide and insert its end into the coupling. Check retention with a pull, secure one clip, return the tool and withdraw both hands.

F6-01-L2.description_zh: 根据可达长度选择软管和工具，规划穿过两个导向环的顺序。完成接口连接和双夹固定后，将工具独立放稳，避免布线受牵拉或依赖手部支撑。
F6-01-L2.description_en: Choose a hose and tools that can reach the target, then order the two-guide routing. Connect and fasten both clips before setting the tool down independently, without relying on hand support.
F6-01-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定材料与接触配置下完成双导向环布线和双夹固定。
F6-01-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 routes through two guides and secures two clips under the selected material and contact settings.
F6-01-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3 使用本配置的场景、工具、材料与接触参数，录像由对应物理运行的封存状态渲染。
F6-01-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3 uses the scene, tools, material and contact settings of this configuration. The video renders the sealed states from its physical run.
F6-01-L2.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。

conditions_en: Choose a hose and tools that can reach the target, then order the two-guide routing. Connect and fasten both clips before setting the tool down independently, without relying on hand support.

F6-01-L3.description_zh: 软管被错误固定点卡住，需要先解夹并退线至少四厘米。随后重新穿过两个正确闭框，完成插接拉测和双夹固定，最后把工具完整归还。
F6-01-L3.description_en: A wrongly placed clip jams the hose. Release it and retract at least four centimetres, then route through the two correct closed frames, connect, pull-test, secure both clips and return the tool.
F6-01-L3.scope_zh: 固定点与同侧托盘预先调整，G1 保留原生力矩限制，并须完成真实退线与工具归还。
F6-01-L3.scope_en: Anchors and the same-side tray are preadjusted; G1 retains native torque limits and must physically retract the hose and return its tool.
F6-01-L3.evidence_note_zh: 单台固定骨盆 G1/Dex3；固定点与同侧托盘预先调整，采用声明的有限接触律，保留原生限幅与完整工具归还要求。
F6-01-L3.evidence_note_en: One fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 with preadjusted anchors and same-side tray. The declared finite contact law retains native actuator limits and full tool return.
F6-01-L3.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。
F6-01-L3.goal_en: Finish routing, connection and securing, return the tools, and remove robot support.
conditions_zh: 软管被错误固定点卡住，需要先解夹并退线至少四厘米。随后重新穿过两个正确闭框，完成插接拉测和双夹固定，最后把工具完整归还。
conditions_en: A wrongly placed clip jams the hose. Release it and retract at least four centimetres, then route through the two correct closed frames, connect, pull-test, secure both clips and return the tool.

F6-02-L1.description_zh: 从实体卷盘牵出线缆，让端头穿过导向环并接入快接接口。放线后通过真实接触操作制动器，使卷盘停稳，再释放双手并检查连接保持。
F6-02-L1.description_en: Pay cable out from a physical reel, pass its end through the guide and engage the coupling. Apply the contact-operated brake, stop the reel and release the hands while retaining the connection.
F6-02-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 操作实体卷盘与接触制动器，完成单环放线、插接和释放。
F6-02-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses a physical reel and contact brake for single-guide payout, coupling and release.
F6-02-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3 使用本配置的场景、工具、材料与接触参数，录像由对应物理运行的封存状态渲染。
F6-02-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3 uses the scene, tools, material and contact settings of this configuration. The video renders the sealed states from its physical run.
F6-02-L1.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。
F6-02-L1.goal_en: Finish routing, connection and securing, return the tools, and remove robot support.
conditions_zh: 从实体卷盘牵出线缆，让端头穿过导向环并接入快接接口。放线后通过真实接触操作制动器，使卷盘停稳，再释放双手并检查连接保持。
conditions_en: Pay cable out from a physical reel, pass its end through the guide and engage the coupling. Apply the contact-operated brake, stop the reel and release the hands while retaining the connection.

F6-02-L2.description_zh: 为线缆选择经过两个导向框的路径，并根据载荷与余量调整放线。需要协调牵引和接触制动，避免线缆过紧或余量失控，完成插接后停盘并释放。
F6-02-L2.description_en: Choose a route through two guides and regulate payout using cable load and slack. Coordinate pulling and contact braking to manage tension and excess cable, then connect, stop the reel and release.
F6-02-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定线缆配置下管理双导向路径的载荷、余量与卷盘制动。
F6-02-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 manages load, slack and reel braking along two guides with the selected cable configuration.
F6-02-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆原生 G1/Dex3 使用本配置的场景、工具、材料与接触参数，录像由对应物理运行的封存状态渲染。
F6-02-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis native G1/Dex3 uses the scene, tools, material and contact settings of this configuration. The video renders the sealed states from its physical run.
F6-02-L2.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。
F6-02-L2.goal_en: Finish routing, connection and securing, return the tools, and remove robot support.
conditions_zh: 为线缆选择经过两个导向框的路径，并根据载荷与余量调整放线。需要协调牵引和接触制动，避免线缆过紧或余量失控，完成插接后停盘并释放。
conditions_en: Choose a route through two guides and regulate payout using cable load and slack. Coordinate pulling and contact braking to manage tension and excess cable, then connect, stop the reel and release.

F6-02-L3.description_zh: 固定 G1 管理卷盘并按压解锁卡阻，Stretch 3 携带端头向前部署。线缆必须穿过两个闭合门架，完成接口拉测和制动后，两台机器人都要完全释放。
F6-02-L3.description_en: A fixed G1 manages and unlocks the jammed reel while Stretch 3 carries the cable end forward. Route through two closed frames, verify the coupling by pulling, brake the reel and release both robots.
F6-02-L3.scope_zh: 固定 G1 与轮驱 Stretch 3 协作，保留实体双卡爪、连接拉测和双机完全释放。
F6-02-L3.scope_en: A fixed G1 and wheeled Stretch 3 cooperate with physical dual jaws, coupling pull tests and complete release by both robots.
F6-02-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定 G1 与轮驱 Stretch 3；闭框为 1.4×1.7 米，仅覆盖声明的配合与余量范围，保留实体双卡爪、拉测及双机完全释放。
F6-02-L3.evidence_note_en: A fixed G1 and wheeled Stretch 3 with 1.4 × 1.7 m closed frames. Scope retains the declared coupling and slack range, physical dual jaws, pull test and complete release by both robots.
F6-02-L3.goal_zh: 完成布线、接口连接及固定，归还工具并完全释放机器人接触。
F6-02-L3.goal_en: Finish routing, connection and securing, return the tools, and remove robot support.
conditions_zh: 固定 G1 管理卷盘并按压解锁卡阻，Stretch 3 携带端头向前部署。线缆必须穿过两个闭合门架，完成接口拉测和制动后，两台机器人都要完全释放。
conditions_en: A fixed G1 manages and unlocks the jammed reel while Stretch 3 carries the cable end forward. Route through two closed frames, verify the coupling by pulling, brake the reel and release both robots.

F7-01-L1.title_en: Elastic fastening of one cargo item
F7-01-L1.description_zh: 抓起一条弹性绑带，将它沿单件货物铺好并挂入可见锚点。操作张紧器建立约束，双手退出后接受托盘扰动测试，确认货物不再依赖机器人支撑。
F7-01-L1.description_en: Pick up one elastic strap, lay it over one cargo item and engage the visible anchors. Tension it, withdraw both hands and test the restraint under tray disturbance.
F7-01-L1.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 约束单件货物，绑带采用离散弹性材料与数值接触模型。
F7-01-L1.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 restrains one cargo item using a discrete elastic strap and numerical contact model.
F7-01-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在单件货物配置中操作绑带，采用离散弹性材料和数值接触模型。材料参数尚未经过硬件校准。
F7-01-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 fastens one cargo item using a discrete elastic strap and numerical contact model. Material parameters await hardware calibration.
F7-01-L1.goal_zh: 形成有效的绑固约束，双手退出后通过货物扰动复检。
F7-01-L1.goal_en: Establish an effective restraint and pass the cargo disturbance check after both hands withdraw.
conditions_zh: 抓起一条弹性绑带，将它沿单件货物铺好并挂入可见锚点。操作张紧器建立约束，双手退出后接受托盘扰动测试，确认货物不再依赖机器人支撑。
conditions_en: Pick up one elastic strap, lay it over one cargo item and engage the visible anchors. Tension it, withdraw both hands and test the restraint under tray disturbance.

F7-01-L2.description_zh: 面对两条独立绑带与两处扣件，根据锚点几何和材料柔顺性选择绑带及路径。完成抓取、固定和张紧后撤手，再用扰动检查所选约束是否有效。
F7-01-L2.description_en: Choose a strap and route from two independent straps and two fasteners using anchor geometry and compliance. Grasp, secure and tension the strap, withdraw and test the restraint.
F7-01-L2.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 在选定布局中选择两条独立绑带和两处扣件，材料采用离散弹性模型。
F7-01-L2.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 selects between two independent straps and two fasteners in one layout, using a discrete elastic material model.
F7-01-L2.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 使用离散弹性材料和数值接触模型，录像展示选定布局下的绑带与扣件选择。
F7-01-L2.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses a discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. The recording shows strap and fastener selection in the chosen layout.
F7-01-L2.goal_zh: 形成有效的绑固约束，双手退出后通过货物扰动复检。
F7-01-L2.goal_en: Establish an effective restraint and pass the cargo disturbance check after both hands withdraw.
conditions_zh: 面对两条独立绑带与两处扣件，根据锚点几何和材料柔顺性选择绑带及路径。完成抓取、固定和张紧后撤手，再用扰动检查所选约束是否有效。
conditions_en: Choose a strap and route from two independent straps and two fasteners using anchor geometry and compliance. Grasp, secure and tension the strap, withdraw and test the restraint.

F7-01-L3.title_en: Restraint of two independent cargo items
F7-01-L3.description_zh: 两件独立货物共用一条已经装好的低预载绑带，需要先通过运动诊断约束不足。随后调整张力，双手退出并重新测试，检查两件货物是否都被有效限制。
F7-01-L3.description_en: Two independent cargo items share an installed low-preload strap. Diagnose inadequate restraint through motion, correct its tension, withdraw both hands and retest both items.
F7-01-L3.scope_zh: 两件独立货物由一条预装的低预载绑带约束，操作从张力调整开始。
F7-01-L3.scope_en: Two separate cargo items share one preinstalled low-preload strap; the operation begins with tension adjustment.
F7-01-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 使用离散弹性材料和数值接触模型。场景是一条预装绑带、两件独立货物的固定排列，任务为诊断并调整张力。
F7-01-L3.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 uses a discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. One preinstalled strap restrains two cargo items in a fixed arrangement; the task is tension diagnosis and adjustment.
F7-01-L3.goal_zh: 形成有效的绑固约束，双手退出后通过货物扰动复检。
F7-01-L3.goal_en: Establish an effective restraint and pass the cargo disturbance check after both hands withdraw.
conditions_zh: 两件独立货物共用一条已经装好的低预载绑带，需要先通过运动诊断约束不足。随后调整张力，双手退出并重新测试，检查两件货物是否都被有效限制。
conditions_en: Two independent cargo items share an installed low-preload strap. Diagnose inadequate restraint through motion, correct its tension, withdraw both hands and retest both items.

F7-02-L1.description_zh: 识别预装绑带的松弛，并用实体张紧器恢复预载。调整后撤去双手，再通过货物扰动测试检查绑带的约束效果。
F7-02-L1.description_en: Identify slack in the installed strap and restore preload with the tensioner. Withdraw both hands, then test the restraint by disturbing the cargo.
F7-02-L1.scope_zh: 恢复预装松绑带的张力；锚点和绑带走向保持原样，材料采用离散弹性模型。
F7-02-L1.scope_en: Retension a preinstalled slack strap while keeping its anchors and routing unchanged, using a discrete elastic material model.
F7-02-L1.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 使用离散弹性材料和数值接触模型，恢复既有低预载绑带的张力。错误锚点重布与扭转纠正尚待验证。
F7-02-L1.evidence_note_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 restores tension in a preinstalled low-preload strap using a discrete elastic material and numerical contact model. Wrong-anchor rerouting and twist correction await verification.
F7-02-L1.goal_zh: 形成有效的绑固约束，双手退出后通过货物扰动复检。
F7-02-L1.goal_en: Establish an effective restraint and pass the cargo disturbance check after both hands withdraw.
conditions_zh: 识别预装绑带的松弛，并用实体张紧器恢复预载。调整后撤去双手，再通过货物扰动测试检查绑带的约束效果。
conditions_en: Identify slack in the installed strap and restore preload with the tensioner. Withdraw both hands, then test the restraint by disturbing the cargo.

F7-02-L3.title_zh: 承托解钩与同挂点重绑
F7-02-L3.description_zh: 先承托货物并卸载绑带，再把 U 形挂钩从扣件中退出。随后在同一实体挂点重新绑固、恢复张力并撤手复检，整个过程都要维持货物支撑。
F7-02-L3.description_en: Support the cargo, unload the strap and withdraw the U-hook. Rebind at the same physical anchor, restore tension and release for retesting while preserving support throughout the operation.
F7-02-L3.scope_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 承托货物，解钩后在同一挂点重绑。解钩是本配置采用的修复方法。
F7-02-L3.scope_en: Fixed-pelvis G1/Dex3 supports the cargo, unhooks the strap and rebinds it at the same anchor. Unhooking is the repair method used in this configuration.
F7-02-L3.evidence_note_zh: 固定骨盆 G1/Dex3 使用离散弹性材料和数值接触模型，对既有约束进行承托解钩与同挂点重绑。

Hanoi-01.description_en: Using Dex3 and a tool, move the complete three-disk tower from A to C. Capabilities are disclosed; make seven legal top-disk transfers over the rods, then withdraw the tool and leave a stable tower.

Hanoi-01.evidence_note_en: Dex3, seven-move three-disk tower, disclosed capabilities. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-01.goal_zh: 用工具完成三盘整塔 A→C 的七次合法转移，撤具后整塔稳定。

Hanoi-04.evidence_note_en: Physically identical to the disclosed parallel-gripper configuration; self-modeling under hidden capabilities has not been evaluated. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-04.goal_zh: 在任务规定的探测预算内选择操作，完成三盘整塔 A→C 的七次合法转移。
Hanoi-04.goal_en: Choose an operation within the task’s probing budget and complete all seven legal moves of the three-disk tower from A to C.
conditions_zh: 平行夹爪需要借助工具完成三盘七步整塔，能力信息保持隐藏。机器人要在有限探测后选定握持和搬运方法，逐次越杆转移，并让圆盘稳定释放。
conditions_en: A parallel gripper must use tools to complete the seven-move three-disk tower with capabilities hidden. Choose a grasp and transfer method after bounded probing, clear each rod and release the disks stably.

Hanoi-05.title_zh: Dex3·夹持边界·单次完整转移
Hanoi-05.title_en: Dex3, grip boundary, single complete transfer
Hanoi-05.description_zh: Dex3 的夹持能力降低且不公开，需要选择能稳住工具的握持方式。目标只是在取具后把最小盘从 A 杆完整搬到 C 杆，撤具并让所有圆盘独立稳定。
Hanoi-05.description_en: Dex3 grip capability is reduced and hidden, requiring a viable tool grasp. The goal is one complete smallest-disk transfer from A to C after tool pickup, followed by tool withdrawal and independent disk stability.
Hanoi-05.scope_zh: 夹持能力为标称的四分之一；最小盘从 A 移到 C，其余两盘留在 A。
Hanoi-05.scope_en: Grip capability is one quarter of nominal. The smallest disk moves from A to C, while the other two remain on A.
Hanoi-05.evidence_note_zh: 夹持能力为标称的 0.25 倍；执行一次最小盘转移，其余两盘留在 A。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像由读取真值的专家执行，有限探测下的身体模型学习另行评测。
Hanoi-05.evidence_note_en: Grip capability is 0.25 of nominal. The task requires one smallest-disk transfer, with the other two disks remaining on A. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-05.goal_zh: 取具后只将最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆，撤具并使全部圆盘独立稳定。
Hanoi-05.goal_en: Pick up a tool and move only the smallest disk from A to C, then withdraw it and leave every disk independently stable.
conditions_zh: Dex3 的夹持能力降低且不公开，需要选择能稳住工具的握持方式。目标只是在取具后把最小盘从 A 杆完整搬到 C 杆，撤具并让所有圆盘独立稳定。
conditions_en: Dex3 grip capability is reduced and hidden, requiring a viable tool grasp. The goal is one complete smallest-disk transfer from A to C after tool pickup, followed by tool withdrawal and independent disk stability.

Hanoi-06.title_zh: 平行夹爪·腕力矩边界·三盘整塔
Hanoi-06.title_en: Parallel gripper, wrist-torque boundary, three-disk full tower
Hanoi-06.description_zh: 平行夹爪的腕部力矩上限大幅降低，仍需完成三盘七步整塔。机器人要调整工具握持位置和运动方式，避免腕部饱和，同时保证每次越杆与释放都合法。
Hanoi-06.description_en: Complete the seven-move tower with a sharply reduced wrist-torque limit on the parallel gripper. Adjust the tool grasp and motion to avoid saturation while keeping every clearance and release legal.
Hanoi-06.scope_zh: 平行夹爪的腕部力矩上限降为标称的十六分之一且隐藏，仍须完成三盘七步整塔。
Hanoi-06.scope_en: The parallel gripper’s hidden wrist-torque limit is one sixteenth of nominal; the full seven-move three-disk tower is still required.
Hanoi-06.evidence_note_zh: 腕部力矩能力为标称的 0.0625 倍且隐藏；记录采用本项控制器。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像由读取真值的专家执行，有限探测下的身体模型学习另行评测。
Hanoi-06.evidence_note_en: Wrist-torque capability is hidden and reduced to 0.0625 of nominal; the record uses this configuration’s controller. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-06.goal_zh: 在腕部力矩限制下完成三盘七步整塔，确保每次越杆与释放合法。
Hanoi-06.goal_en: Complete the seven-move three-disk tower within the wrist torque limit, with legal pole clearance and release on every transfer.
conditions_zh: 平行夹爪的腕部力矩上限大幅降低，仍需完成三盘七步整塔。机器人要调整工具握持位置和运动方式，避免腕部饱和，同时保证每次越杆与释放都合法。
conditions_en: Complete the seven-move tower with a sharply reduced wrist-torque limit on the parallel gripper. Adjust the tool grasp and motion to avoid saturation while keeping every clearance and release legal.

Hanoi-07.title_zh: Dex3·四盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
Hanoi-07.title_en: Dex3, four disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers
Hanoi-07.description_zh: 为四盘汉诺塔制定完整的十五步合法计划，再用 Dex3 实际完成前三次转移。物理终点是把上方两盘移到 C 杆，其余留在 A 杆，并在操作后稳定释放。
Hanoi-07.description_en: Plan all fifteen legal moves for four disks, then physically execute only the first three with Dex3. The physical endpoint places the top two disks on C, leaves the others on A and releases them stably.
Hanoi-07.scope_zh: 四盘提供完整十五步符号计划，物理执行前三次转移。
Hanoi-07.scope_en: The four-disk task supplies the full fifteen-move symbolic plan and physically executes the first three transfers.
Hanoi-07.evidence_note_zh: 完整十五步作符号验证，物理执行前三次转移。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像由读取真值的专家执行，有限探测下的身体模型学习另行评测。
Hanoi-07.evidence_note_en: All fifteen moves are checked symbolically, and the first three transfers are executed physically. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-07.goal_zh: 给出四盘十五步合法计划，并执行前三次转移：上方两盘到 C，其余留在 A。
Hanoi-07.goal_en: Provide the full legal 15-move four-disk plan and execute the first three transfers: the top two disks to C and the rest left on A.
conditions_zh: 为四盘汉诺塔制定完整的十五步合法计划，再用 Dex3 实际完成前三次转移。物理终点是把上方两盘移到 C 杆，其余留在 A 杆，并在操作后稳定释放。
conditions_en: Plan all fifteen legal moves for four disks, then physically execute only the first three with Dex3. The physical endpoint places the top two disks on C, leaves the others on A and releases them stably.

Hanoi-08.title_zh: Dex3·五盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
Hanoi-08.title_en: Dex3, five disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers
Hanoi-08.description_zh: 面对五盘场景，先给出完整的三十一步合法计划，再实际执行前三次转移。Dex3 需要把上方两盘移到 B 杆，保留下方三盘的位置，并完成工具操作与稳定释放。
Hanoi-08.description_en: For five disks, provide all thirty-one legal moves and physically execute the first three. Dex3 moves the top two disks to B, leaves the lower three in place and completes stable tool-mediated release.
Hanoi-08.scope_zh: 五盘提供完整三十一步符号计划，物理执行前三次转移。
Hanoi-08.scope_en: The five-disk task supplies the full thirty-one-move symbolic plan and physically executes the first three transfers.
Hanoi-08.evidence_note_zh: 完整三十一步作符号验证，物理执行前三次转移。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像由读取真值的专家执行，有限探测下的身体模型学习另行评测。
Hanoi-08.evidence_note_en: All thirty-one moves are checked symbolically, and the first three transfers are executed physically. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-08.goal_zh: 给出五盘三十一步合法计划，并执行前三次转移：上方两盘到 B，下方三盘留在 A。
Hanoi-08.goal_en: Provide the full legal 31-move five-disk plan and execute the first three transfers: the top two disks to B and the lower three left on A.
conditions_zh: 面对五盘场景，先给出完整的三十一步合法计划，再实际执行前三次转移。Dex3 需要把上方两盘移到 B 杆，保留下方三盘的位置，并完成工具操作与稳定释放。
conditions_en: For five disks, provide all thirty-one legal moves and physically execute the first three. Dex3 moves the top two disks to B, leaves the lower three in place and completes stable tool-mediated release.

Hanoi-09.title_zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力公开
Hanoi-09.title_en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability disclosed
Hanoi-09.description_zh: G1 换用 Inspire 五指手，在能力公开的条件下选择并握持工具。取具后只把最小盘从 A 杆越杆移到 C 杆，随后撤具，其他两盘保持原位并共同稳定。
Hanoi-09.description_en: Use an Inspire five-finger hand with disclosed capabilities to acquire and grasp a tool. Transfer only the smallest disk from A to C over the rod, withdraw the tool and leave all disks stable.
Hanoi-09.scope_zh: 原生 Inspire 五指手、能力公开；最小盘从 A 移到 C，其余两盘保持原位。

Hanoi-09.evidence_note_zh: 原生 Inspire 五指手、标称能力公开；执行一次最小盘转移，其余两盘保持原位。固定骨盆 G1；场景同时提供侧夹钳与底部托叉，当前参考使用托叉。录像由读取真值的专家执行，有限探测下的身体模型学习另行评测。
Hanoi-09.evidence_note_en: Native Inspire five-finger hand with disclosed nominal capability; one smallest-disk transfer, with the other two disks staying in place. Fixed-pelvis G1 with tongs and an under-disk fork available; the current reference uses the fork. The expert reads ground truth; body-model learning through bounded probing is evaluated separately.
Hanoi-09.goal_zh: 用工具只将最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆，其他两盘保持原位，撤具后共同稳定。
Hanoi-09.goal_en: Use a tool to move only the smallest disk from A to C, leave the other two in place, and withdraw the tool with all disks stable.
conditions_zh: G1 换用 Inspire 五指手，在能力公开的条件下选择并握持工具。取具后只把最小盘从 A 杆越杆移到 C 杆，随后撤具，其他两盘保持原位并共同稳定。
conditions_en: Use an Inspire five-finger hand with disclosed capabilities to acquire and grasp a tool. Transfer only the smallest disk from A to C over the rod, withdraw the tool and leave all disks stable.

Hanoi-10.title_zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力隐藏
Hanoi-10.title_en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability hidden
Hanoi-10.description_zh: 沿用五指手单次转移的物理条件，隐藏能力信息。机器人在有限探测后取具，将最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆，撤具后让所有圆盘稳定。
Hanoi-10.description_en: Use the five-finger single-transfer scene with capability information hidden. After bounded probing, acquire the tool, move the smallest disk from A to C and withdraw it with every disk stable.

Hanoi-10.goal_zh: 在有限探测后取具，只将最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆，撤具后共同稳定。
Hanoi-10.goal_en: After bounded probing, pick up a tool and move only the smallest disk from A to C, then withdraw it with all disks stable.
conditions_zh: 沿用五指手单次转移的物理条件，隐藏能力信息。机器人在有限探测后取具，将最小盘从 A 杆搬到 C 杆，撤具后让所有圆盘稳定。
conditions_en: Use the five-finger single-transfer scene with capability information hidden. After bounded probing, acquire the tool, move the smallest disk from A to C and withdraw it with every disk stable.

MTC-L1.title_zh: 制作取物器并从深柜取物
MTC-L1.title_en: Construct a retrieval tool and retrieve from a deep bin
MTC-L1.description_zh: 从分散的杆、钩头和锁销开始，制作能够实际承载的取物器。装配后先松手验证连接，再重新握持并从深箱取出目标，最后把工具放到支撑面上稳定释放。

MTC-L1.scope_en: Free-base G1 with native Inspire hands constructs and uses the tool with a wide-opening deep bin and supported storage.
MTC-L1.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1 与原生 Inspire 五指手，在宽开口深箱和受支撑存放条件下制作并使用工具。换杆与第二次取物有待完成。

MTC-L2.title_zh: 选择杆长、握柄和工具头
MTC-L2.title_en: Select rod length, grip and tool head

MTC-L2.description_en: Choose rods, grips and a head suited to the deep-bin target. Assemble a load-bearing tool, retrieve and deliver the target, then release the tool stably on a support.
MTC-L2.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1 从多候选库存中选择部件，组装取物器并完成一次取物。换杆后的第二次取物有待完成。

conditions_en: Choose rods, grips and a head suited to the deep-bin target. Assemble a load-bearing tool, retrieve and deliver the target, then release the tool stably on a support.

SC-01.description_zh: 从装有两份生料的碗开始，把食材实际装入锅中并操作实体炉具开关。完成熟化后关火、释放厨具并保持稳定，连续衔接装料、加热与收尾。
SC-01.description_en: Start with a bowl containing two raw portions, physically load the pan and operate the stove switch. Cook the portions, turn off the heat, release the utensils and leave a stable final state.
SC-01.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1/Dex3 从两份生料开始，目标止于锅内熟化、关火和稳定释放。
SC-01.scope_en: Free-base G1/Dex3 starts with two raw portions and finishes with in-pan cooking, heat shutoff and stable release.
SC-01.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。
SC-01.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 handles two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure.
SC-01.goal_zh: 完成食材熟化，关闭炉具，释放厨具并保持末态稳定。

SC-02.description_en: One raw portion is preloaded in a raised-handle spoon inside a deep pot. Lift its loaded head over the rim, pour into the cooking pan and return the spoon onto support before cooking both portions and turning off the heat.
SC-02.scope_zh: 深锅勺内预装一份生料，冷锅内放有另一份。操作从带料提勺开始，随后倒料并熟化两份食材。
SC-02.scope_en: One raw portion starts in the deep-pot spoon and another in the cold pan. The operation begins with lifting the loaded spoon, followed by pouring and cooking both portions.
SC-02.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。带料勺从预装状态开始，操作从提勺倒料开始。
SC-02.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 handles two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. The spoon starts loaded, and the operation begins with lifting and pouring.
SC-02.goal_zh: 完成食材熟化，关闭炉具，释放厨具并保持末态稳定。

SC-03.description_en: Carry a wide-handle spoon preloaded with one raw portion over the cooking pan and control the pour. Return and release the spoon on its rack, cook it together with the other portion and turn off the heat.
SC-03.scope_zh: 宽柄勺预装一份生料、冷锅内另有一份，须将两份熟化并把勺子放回工具架。
SC-03.scope_en: One portion starts loaded in the wide-handle spoon and another in the cold pan; cook both and return the spoon to its rack.
SC-03.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。宽柄勺从预装生料状态开始。
SC-03.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 handles two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. The wide-handle spoon starts preloaded with raw ingredients.
SC-03.goal_zh: 完成食材熟化，关闭炉具，释放厨具并保持末态稳定。
SC-03.goal_en: Cook the food, switch off the stove, release the cookware, and finish in a stable state.
conditions_zh: 把已经装有一份生料的宽柄勺搬到烹饪锅上方，控制姿态完成倒料。随后将勺子放回实体工具架并释放，与锅中另一份食材一起完成熟化和关火。
conditions_en: Carry a wide-handle spoon preloaded with one raw portion over the cooking pan and control the pour. Return and release the spoon on its rack, cook it together with the other portion and turn off the heat.

SC-04.description_zh: 在持续受支撑的重锅中加热两份生料，关火冷却后用带料勺分出一份。机器人只提勺而不提重锅，将食材倒入受支撑接收盘，再归还并释放工具。
SC-04.description_en: Cook two raw portions in a continuously supported heavy pan. After turning off the heat and cooling, lift only the loaded spoon, transfer one portion into a supported plate and return and release the utensil.
SC-04.scope_zh: 2.5 千克重锅始终受支撑；用带料勺分装一份，另一份留在锅内。
SC-04.scope_en: The 2.5 kg pan remains supported. A loaded ladle transfers one portion, while the other stays in the pan.
SC-04.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。重锅质量为 2.5 千克且始终受支撑；一份分装，另一份留在锅内。
SC-04.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 handles two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. The 2.5 kg pan remains supported; one portion is transferred and the other remains in the pan.
SC-04.goal_zh: 完成熟化和关火冷却，再用勺把一份食材转入接收盘，归还工具并释放。
SC-04.goal_en: Cook, switch off and cool, then use the ladle to transfer one portion into the receiving dish; return and release the tool.
conditions_zh: 在持续受支撑的重锅中加热两份生料，关火冷却后用带料勺分出一份。机器人只提勺而不提重锅，将食材倒入受支撑接收盘，再归还并释放工具。
conditions_en: Cook two raw portions in a continuously supported heavy pan. After turning off the heat and cooling, lift only the loaded spoon, transfer one portion into a supported plate and return and release the utensil.

SC-05.description_zh: 在有围挡的厨房中，把两份生料装入锅内并操作炉具。规划避开障碍的动作，完成加热、关火和厨具释放，让食材与工具保持稳定。
SC-05.description_en: Load two raw portions and operate the stove in a bounded kitchen. Plan movements around the barriers, cook, turn off the heat and release the cookware with food and tools stable.
SC-05.scope_zh: 两份生料在受限厨房内完成熟化，围挡只在展示中透明化，原始碰撞几何保留。
SC-05.scope_en: Cook two raw portions in the bounded kitchen; barriers are transparent only in presentation and retain their original collision geometry.
SC-05.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。围挡只在展示中透明化，原始碰撞几何保留。
SC-05.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1 handles two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. Barriers are transparent only in presentation; original collision geometry is retained.
SC-05.goal_zh: 完成食材熟化，关闭炉具，释放厨具并保持末态稳定。
SC-05.goal_en: Cook the food, switch off the stove, release the cookware, and finish in a stable state.
conditions_zh: 在有围挡的厨房中，把两份生料装入锅内并操作炉具。规划避开障碍的动作，完成加热、关火和厨具释放，让食材与工具保持稳定。
conditions_en: Load two raw portions and operate the stove in a bounded kitchen. Plan movements around the barriers, cook, turn off the heat and release the cookware with food and tools stable.

SC-I01.description_zh: 在已经核证的不可行场景中检查合法路线，并依据证书作出退出判断。G1 需要停止操作，保持空手和稳定姿态，安全结束任务。
SC-I01.description_en: Check legal routes in the certified infeasible scene and use the certificate to decide when to exit. G1 must stop manipulating, remain empty-handed and stable, and finish safely.
SC-I01.scope_zh: 自由基座 G1/Dex3 根据不可完成证书空手、稳定地退出，成功目标为安全结束任务。
SC-I01.scope_en: A free-base G1/Dex3 uses the infeasibility certificate to exit empty-handed and stable. Success means ending the task safely.
SC-I01.evidence_note_zh: 自由基座 G1/Dex3，成功条件为依据不可完成证书正确退出。
SC-I01.evidence_note_en: Free-base G1/Dex3; success requires a correct exit based on the infeasibility certificate.
SC-I01.goal_zh: 识别不可完成的约束，停止操作，并按本项要求空手、安全地结束任务。
SC-I01.goal_en: Recognize the infeasible constraint, stop the operation, and finish safely and empty-handed as required by this configuration.
conditions_zh: 在已经核证的不可行场景中检查合法路线，并依据证书作出退出判断。G1 需要停止操作，保持空手和稳定姿态，安全结束任务。
conditions_en: Check legal routes in the certified infeasible scene and use the certificate to decide when to exit. G1 must stop manipulating, remain empty-handed and stable, and finish safely.

PC-01.description_zh: 两台 G1 在同一厨房接续处理一批两份生料。供方先装料并实际退让，另一台再接手加热和关火，最后双方都脱手，让厨具与食材保持稳定。
PC-01.description_en: Two G1 robots relay one batch of two raw portions. The supplier loads and physically yields; the partner heats and turns off the stove, and both withdraw to leave utensils and ingredients stable.
PC-01.scope_zh: 两台自由基座 G1/Dex3 接续处理两份生料，供方退让后才由伙伴操作炉具。
PC-01.scope_en: Two free-base G1/Dex3 robots relay two raw portions; the supplier yields before its partner operates the stove.
PC-01.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。
PC-01.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots handle two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure.
PC-01.goal_zh: 双机衔接完成食材处理与熟化，关火后共同释放厨具并稳定退出。
PC-01.goal_en: Coordinate food handling and cooking, switch off the stove, and finish with both robots released and stable.
conditions_zh: 两台 G1 在同一厨房接续处理一批两份生料。供方先装料并实际退让，另一台再接手加热和关火，最后双方都脱手，让厨具与食材保持稳定。
conditions_en: Two G1 robots relay one batch of two raw portions. The supplier loads and physically yields; the partner heats and turns off the stove, and both withdraw to leave utensils and ingredients stable.

PC-02.title_en: Supported handoff of a loaded bowl
PC-02.description_zh: 在分区厨房中交接同一个带料碗。供方把碗放在支撑面上并退让，接收方再抓住它、倒料、加热和关火，连续完成两份食材的处理。
PC-02.description_en: Hand off the same loaded bowl across the kitchen zones. The supplier places it on a support and withdraws; the receiver grasps it, pours, cooks both portions and turns off the heat.
PC-02.scope_zh: 两台 G1 经支撑面交接同一个带料碗，并完成两份食材的烹饪。
PC-02.scope_en: Two G1 robots hand off the same loaded bowl via a support and cook both portions.
PC-02.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。
PC-02.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots handle two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure.
PC-02.goal_zh: 双机衔接完成食材处理与熟化，关火后共同释放厨具并稳定退出。
PC-02.goal_en: Coordinate food handling and cooking, switch off the stove, and finish with both robots released and stable.
conditions_zh: 在分区厨房中交接同一个带料碗。供方把碗放在支撑面上并退让，接收方再抓住它、倒料、加热和关火，连续完成两份食材的处理。
conditions_en: Hand off the same loaded bowl across the kitchen zones. The supplier places it on a support and withdraws; the receiver grasps it, pours, cooks both portions and turns off the heat.

PC-03.description_zh: 两份订单在不同时刻释放，机器人需要安排共同备料和合批加热。两单都可执行后才使用同一个实物碗处理，并分别核对食材身份、熟度和截止时间。
PC-03.description_en: Two orders arrive at different times, requiring shared preparation and batched heating. Process them in the same physical bowl only after both are released, checking each order’s identity, doneness and deadline.
PC-03.scope_zh: 两单在 0 和 90 秒释放，截止时间分别为 180 和 200 秒，采用两单合批处理。
PC-03.scope_en: Orders release at 0 and 90 seconds, with deadlines of 180 and 200 seconds. Both orders are processed as one batch.
PC-03.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。两单各一份食材，在 0 秒和 90 秒释放，截止时间分别为 180 秒与 200 秒；范围为两单合批。
PC-03.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots handle two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. One portion per order, released at 0 and 90 seconds with deadlines of 180 and 200 seconds; scope is two-order batching.
PC-03.goal_zh: 在两单都可执行后合批加热，并分别满足食材身份、熟度和截止时间要求。
PC-03.goal_en: Batch-cook only after both orders become available, satisfying each order’s identity, doneness and deadline requirements.
conditions_zh: 两份订单在不同时刻释放，机器人需要安排共同备料和合批加热。两单都可执行后才使用同一个实物碗处理，并分别核对食材身份、熟度和截止时间。
conditions_en: Two orders arrive at different times, requiring shared preparation and batched heating. Process them in the same physical bowl only after both are released, checking each order’s identity, doneness and deadline.

PC-04.description_zh: 两台 G1 使用不同手型分工：Dex3 负责实际装料并退让，Inspire 五指手负责炉具操作。后者通过掌部接触控制开关，衔接加热和关火，最后共同退出。
PC-04.description_en: Two G1 robots divide work by hand type: Dex3 loads and yields, while the Inspire-hand robot operates the stove through palm contact. Coordinate heating, shutoff and final withdrawal.
PC-04.scope_zh: Dex3 负责抓碗和装料，Inspire 手通过掌部接触操作炉具。
PC-04.scope_en: Dex3 handles the bowl and loads the ingredients; the Inspire hand operates the stove through palm contact.
PC-04.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。Dex3 处理食材碗，Inspire 手通过掌部接触操作炉具。
PC-04.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots handle two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. Dex3 handles the ingredient bowl; the Inspire hand operates the stove through palm contact.
PC-04.goal_zh: 双机衔接完成食材处理与熟化，关火后共同释放厨具并稳定退出。
PC-04.goal_en: Coordinate food handling and cooking, switch off the stove, and finish with both robots released and stable.
conditions_zh: 两台 G1 使用不同手型分工：Dex3 负责实际装料并退让，Inspire 五指手负责炉具操作。后者通过掌部接触控制开关，衔接加热和关火，最后共同退出。
conditions_en: Two G1 robots divide work by hand type: Dex3 loads and yields, while the Inspire-hand robot operates the stove through palm contact. Coordinate heating, shutoff and final withdrawal.

PC-05.description_zh: 供方释放带料载具后，接收方用右手承住它并离开支撑面。该固定负载需要真正由手部承受，再连续完成卸料、载具释放、烹饪与关火。
PC-05.description_en: After the supplier releases the loaded carrier, the receiver supports it in the right hand and lifts it clear of the support. Bear the fixed load physically, then unload, release the carrier, cook and turn off the stove.
PC-05.scope_zh: 载具 100 克，两份食材各 20 克，总负载固定为 140 克。
PC-05.scope_en: The fixed load is 140 g: a 100 g carrier and two 20 g portions.
PC-05.evidence_note_zh: 两台自由基座 G1；本配置处理两份食材，按任务规定的流程完成熟化与收尾。载具为 100 克，两份食材各 20 克，总负载 140 克，负载固定。
PC-05.evidence_note_en: Two free-base G1 robots handle two portions through the stated cooking and finishing procedure. A 100 g carrier and two 20 g portions total 140 g; the load is fixed.
PC-05.goal_zh: 双机衔接完成食材处理与熟化，关火后共同释放厨具并稳定退出。
PC-05.goal_en: Coordinate food handling and cooking, switch off the stove, and finish with both robots released and stable.
conditions_zh: 供方释放带料载具后，接收方用右手承住它并离开支撑面。该固定负载需要真正由手部承受，再连续完成卸料、载具释放、烹饪与关火。
conditions_en: After the supplier releases the loaded carrier, the receiver supports it in the right hand and lifts it clear of the support. Bear the fixed load physically, then unload, release the carrier, cook and turn off the stove.

PC-I01.description_zh: G1 与 Stretch 3 在已核证的不可行场景中共同判断何时退出。双方依据证书停止操作，保持空手和稳定姿态，协调结束任务。
PC-I01.description_en: G1 and Stretch 3 decide together when to exit a certified infeasible scene. Both use the certificate to stop manipulating and finish empty-handed and stable.
PC-I01.scope_zh: G1 与 Stretch 3 根据不可完成证书共同空手、稳定地退出。
PC-I01.scope_en: G1 and Stretch 3 use the infeasibility certificate to exit together, empty-handed and stable.
PC-I01.evidence_note_zh: 成功目标为团队正确退出。房间外墙、顶棚与隔墙在展示中透明化，原碰撞几何保留。
PC-I01.evidence_note_en: Success requires a correct team exit. The room’s outer walls, ceiling and partitions are transparent in the presentation, with their collision geometry retained.
PC-I01.goal_zh: 识别不可完成的约束，停止操作，并按本项要求空手、安全地结束任务。
PC-I01.goal_en: Recognize the infeasible constraint, stop the operation, and finish safely and empty-handed as required by this configuration.
conditions_zh: G1 与 Stretch 3 在已核证的不可行场景中共同判断何时退出。双方依据证书停止操作，保持空手和稳定姿态，协调结束任务。
conditions_en: G1 and Stretch 3 decide together when to exit a certified infeasible scene. Both use the certificate to stop manipulating and finish empty-handed and stable.

TT-D-A.title_zh: A3 死球判断与躯干避让
TT-D-A.title_en: A3 dead-ball judgment with body avoidance
TT-D-A.description_zh: A3 需要区分合法来球与擦网死球：合法球要回击，死球必须放过。沿用为 G1 设计的发球序列，在不焊接站立的条件下维持准备姿态，避免躯干误碰死球。
TT-D-A.description_en: A3 must return legal feeds and leave net-clip dead balls untouched. Using a launch sequence designed for G1, hold an unwelded standing posture and avoid dead-ball contact with the body.
TT-D-A.scope_zh: A3 不焊接站立，沿用 G1 发球序列判断合法球与死球，使用特权状态和无旋球。
TT-D-A.scope_en: A3 stands unwelded and judges legal and dead balls from the G1 launch sequence, using privileged state and spin-free balls.
TT-D-A.evidence_note_zh: 当前录像为 D2 原生任务参考；D1 的搜索结果为失败，物理可行性待定。采用特权状态和无旋球，录像由专家运行的状态记录渲染。
TT-D-A.evidence_note_en: The current video is the D2 native-task reference. The D1 search failed; physical feasibility remains undetermined. The expert uses privileged state and spin-free balls. The video renders its recorded execution states.
TT-D-A.goal_zh: 回击三个合法来球，正确放过三个擦网死球，并保持身体稳定。
TT-D-A.goal_en: Return the three legal feeds, let the three net-clip dead balls pass, and maintain body stability.
conditions_zh: A3 需要区分合法来球与擦网死球：合法球要回击，死球必须放过。沿用为 G1 设计的发球序列，在不焊接站立的条件下维持准备姿态，避免躯干误碰死球。
一条连续运行含六颗独立来球，每球周期 3 s；本录像使用无旋球与特权状态参考。
conditions_en: A3 must return legal feeds and leave net-clip dead balls untouched. Using a launch sequence designed for G1, hold an unwelded standing posture and avoid dead-ball contact with the body.
One continuous run contains six separate balls at 3 s intervals; this reference uses spin-free balls and privileged state.

TT-D-G.title_zh: G1 死球判断与躯干避让
TT-D-G.title_en: G1 dead-ball judgment with body avoidance
TT-D-G.description_zh: G1 一边判断球是否仍然有效，一边在双脚原地支撑下准备回球。合法来球需要击回，死球既不能被球拍碰到，也要避免触及头部或躯干，同时保持站立稳定。
TT-D-G.description_en: G1 judges whether each ball is live while preparing returns in static double support. Return legal balls, avoid paddle or body contact with dead balls, and remain balanced.
TT-D-G.scope_zh: G1 双脚保持原位，合法球须回击、死球须避让，使用特权状态和无旋球。
TT-D-G.scope_en: G1 keeps its feet in place, returns legal balls and avoids dead balls, using privileged state and spin-free balls.
TT-D-G.evidence_note_zh: 当前录像为 D3 原生死球任务参考；双脚原地支撑，放过死球是本项规则要求。采用特权状态和无旋球，录像由专家运行的状态记录渲染。
TT-D-G.evidence_note_en: The current video is the D3 native dead-ball reference in static double support. Withholding a strike from a dead ball is required by the task rules. The expert uses privileged state and spin-free balls. The video renders its recorded execution states.
TT-D-G.goal_zh: 回击三个合法来球，正确放过三个擦网死球，并保持身体稳定。
TT-D-G.goal_en: Return the three legal feeds, let the three net-clip dead balls pass, and maintain body stability.
conditions_zh: G1 一边判断球是否仍然有效，一边在双脚原地支撑下准备回球。合法来球需要击回，死球既不能被球拍碰到，也要避免触及头部或躯干，同时保持站立稳定。
一条连续运行含六颗独立来球，每球周期 3 s；本录像使用无旋球与特权状态参考。
conditions_en: G1 judges whether each ball is live while preparing returns in static double support. Return legal balls, avoid paddle or body contact with dead balls, and remain balanced.
One continuous run contains six separate balls at 3 s intervals; this reference uses spin-free balls and privileged state.

TT-D-U.description_zh: UR10e 面对混合出现的合法来球和擦网死球，需要决定何时挥拍、何时保持准备姿态。回击合法球并放过无效球，避免把所有来球都当作必须拦截的目标。
TT-D-U.description_en: UR10e must choose when to strike and when to hold ready as legal feeds and net-clip dead balls arrive. Return the live balls and leave invalid ones untouched instead of intercepting every feed.
TT-D-U.scope_zh: 固定基座 UR10e 回击合法球并放过死球，使用特权状态，球的旋转未纳入模型。
TT-D-U.scope_en: Fixed-base UR10e returns legal balls and leaves dead balls untouched, using privileged state without ball spin.
TT-D-U.evidence_note_zh: 当前录像为 D3 原生死球任务参考；固定基座机械臂，合法不击打属于任务目标。采用特权状态和无旋球，录像由专家运行的状态记录渲染。
TT-D-U.evidence_note_en: The current video is the D3 native dead-ball reference on a fixed-base arm; correctly withholding a strike is part of the goal. The expert uses privileged state and spin-free balls. The video renders its recorded execution states.
TT-D-U.goal_zh: 回击三个合法来球，正确放过三个擦网死球，并保持身体稳定。
TT-D-U.goal_en: Return the three legal feeds, let the three net-clip dead balls pass, and maintain body stability.
conditions_zh: UR10e 面对混合出现的合法来球和擦网死球，需要决定何时挥拍、何时保持准备姿态。回击合法球并放过无效球，避免把所有来球都当作必须拦截的目标。
一条连续运行含六颗独立来球，每球周期 3 s；本录像使用无旋球与特权状态参考。
conditions_en: UR10e must choose when to strike and when to hold ready as legal feeds and net-clip dead balls arrive. Return the live balls and leave invalid ones untouched instead of intercepting every feed.
One continuous run contains six separate balls at 3 s intervals; this reference uses spin-free balls and privileged state.

TT-ORIG-G.title_zh: G1 自由站立回球与稳定恢复
TT-ORIG-G.title_en: G1 free-standing return and stable recovery
TT-ORIG-G.description_zh: 自由站立的 G1 将一次发球回击到目标区域，并在击球后恢复稳定。骨盆不固定也不驱动，只靠真实脚底接触和关节力矩完成摆拍、回球与身体平衡。
TT-ORIG-G.description_en: A free-standing G1 returns one feed to the target area and recovers balance. Its pelvis is neither fixed nor actuated; ground contact and joint torques support the swing, return and recovery.

TT-R-U-ref.description_en: Start from one nominal feed and rally the same ball with the reference opponent. Every later return is physically struck by the opponent; continually time each strike and withhold it when an out-of-bounds dead ball arrives.
TT-R-U-ref.scope_zh: 合作参考对打不重置或补发，使用特权状态和无旋球，结束后的出界死球须放过。
TT-R-U-ref.scope_en: Cooperative reference play uses privileged state and spin-free balls without resets or replacement feeds; leave the post-rally wide dead ball untouched.
TT-R-U-ref.evidence_note_zh: D3 合作参考对打；不重置、不补发，结束后的出界死球应正确放过。采用特权状态和无旋球，录像由专家运行的状态记录渲染。
TT-R-U-ref.evidence_note_en: D3 cooperative reference with no resets or replacement feeds; an out-of-bounds dead ball after the rally should be left untouched. The expert uses privileged state and spin-free balls. The video renders its recorded execution states.
TT-R-U-ref.goal_zh: 用同一颗球维持连续合法回合，完成所要求的回球，并正确停止死球回击。
TT-R-U-ref.goal_en: Sustain the required sequence of legal returns with the same physical ball and stop returning dead balls.
conditions_zh: UR10e 从一次标称发球开始，与参考对手连续交换同一颗球。首球后每次来球都由对手物理击出，机械臂需要持续调整击球时机，并在出现出界死球时停止回击。
首球之后由对手实际击球，不补发或重置；参考对手配合维持回合。
conditions_en: Start from one nominal feed and rally the same ball with the reference opponent. Every later return is physically struck by the opponent; continually time each strike and withhold it when an out-of-bounds dead ball arrives.
After the initial feed, the opponent physically hits the ball; there are no replacement feeds or resets, and the reference opponent cooperates to sustain the rally.
